town_description: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, set in the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas within the Itanagar Capital Complex. Its twin town Naharlagun, about 10 km north on NH-52A, is the region's commercial centre and railhead, and the two towns function as a single urban area together with Nirjuli; landmarks nearby include the Ita Fort ramparts and the Jawaharlal Nehru Museum.
